tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// mgon po'i bskang ba g.yul las rnam rgyal bzhugs so//

༄༅// nus mthu'i gser gyi rtsibs stong mkhar 'phags pas// yon tan chen pos phas bsu mdzad pas na// phyogs las rnam rgyal dngos grub ster ba'i lha// bya rog mtshan can de la phyag 'tshal lo// mdun gyi rten rnams mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang las/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang*// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' che// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// deng nas brtsams te mgon med bdag /byang chub snying po ma thob bar// 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa chen po las// bdag dang 'gro rnams bskyab pa'i phyir// rkang gnyis gtso bo sku gsum bdag /bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su mchi// 'dod chags bral zhing mya ngan 'das// zhi ba'i chos la skyabs su mchi// tshogs kyi mchog gyur sa la bzhugs// phyir mi ldog la skyabs su mchi// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// bla ma mchog la skyabs su mchi// dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha// dkyil 'khor lha la skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor ma// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i// gnyug ma'i sems la skyabs su mchi// bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis// sngon chad sdig pa ci bgyis pa// mgon po khyed kyi spyan sngar bshags// phyin chad sdig las ldog par bgyi// deng nas khyod kyi 'bangs su mchi// khyod kyi bslab bya rjes su slob// khyod kyi bka' las mi 'da' bas// kun nas yongs su bskyab tu gsol// zhes skyabs 'gro lan gsum/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad ltar// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos rnams sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god//

ces sems bskyed lan gsum/ rang gi phung khams skye mched thams cad lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad ma dang*/ zla ba dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ dar gyis klubs pa'i gdan gyi steng du bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam par bzhugs pa'i spyi bo nas yar brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams mtho brtsegs kyi tshul du bzhugs shing*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa sprin gtibs pa'i tshul du bzhugs par gyur// bdag gi lus dang longs spyod thams cad dang*// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba ma lus kun// skyes mchog khyed kyi 'bangs su 'bul lags na// thugs rjes dgongs te bzhes nas bskyab tu gsol// ston pa gsang bdag ind+ri bhū ti dang*// klu yi rnal 'byor ma dang sa ra ha// klu sgrub 'phags pa lha dang klu'i byang chub// dus zhabs che chung rdo rje gdan pa dang*// a bha ya dang tsa mi dpal rgwa lo// tshul khrims 'byung gnas rdo rje dbang phyug dang*// phag gru zhang dang gling ras gtsang pa rgya// seng ge'i mtshan dgu bsam rgyal kha che dang*// rigs gsum rnam sprul rgyal dbang rje yab sras// chos grags mthu stobs zhabs dang padma dkar// gzhan yang mgon po'i dbang brgyud man ngag gi /bla ma kun la snying nas gsol ba 'debs// bstan srungs mthu dang dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol// bla ma rnams 'od du zhu rang la bstim/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang phrad na ci ma rung snyam pa'i byams pa dang*/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral na ci ma rung snyam pa'i snying rje dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba de yang rgyun brtan na ci ma rung snyam pa'i dga' ba dang*/ sems cad thams cad yang dag pa'i lam la gnas na ci ma rung snyam pa'i btang snyoms la gnas par bya'o// oṃ swa bhā washuddhāḥsarba dharm+māḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/

bdag dang dngos po'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las ri rab kyi steng du sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pa/ sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i snying ga mnan pa/ g.yon cung zad bskum pas 'jigs byed sngon po'i dpral ba mnan pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ nor bu dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa'o// de'i pang na yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ gcer bu skra grol zhing*/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i phyag rgyas lngas brgyan pa/ kha ṭwāṃ ga dang thod pas mtshan pa'i phyag g.yon pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud cing*/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub steng gi nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ zhabs g.yas pa yab la 'khyud cing g.yon yab dang lhan cig tu brkyang ba/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur pa'i spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la bla ma mi bskyod pa'i gzugs can gyis dbu brgyan cing thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ ces chu las chu bur lta bur stong pa nyid las sa bon med par skad cig gis ldang bar bya'o// de ltar bsgoms nas slar snod bcud rnams rang gi lus la/ lus yas mas nas rim gyis snying ga'i hūm̐/ de ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin la/

de yang zhabs kyu ha/ zla tshes thig le/ nā da la me long la has btab pa 'du ba ltar bsgoms nas thams cad stong pa 'od gsal la mnyam par gzhag cing*/ mi gnas na 'od gsal de las chu las nya ldang ba lta bur sngar ji lta bar langs te snying ga'i sa bon gyi mthar/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hu hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pas bskor te ngag tu bzla la/ de'i tshe sngags bcas 'od zer rtse la dpal 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum gyi sku bzhugs pa 'jig rten gsum du spros pas thams cad kyi sdig pa sbyangs/ dge la bkod pa'i mthar 'khor lo sdom pa'i go 'phang grub ste 'od zer slar 'dus par bsam mo// de nas/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛ hṇa gṛ hṇa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛ hṇa pa ya gṛ hṇa pa ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wan badzre huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces lan gsum/ thugs ka nas khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros te spos chu la thim pas khro bo rnams chu'i rnam par gyur pa des dngos po gang la gtor zhing reg pas nyes skyon gyi dri ma dag par byed pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i chur gyur/ chu byin brlabs/ ha ho hrīḥ lhan skyes dkar po'i thugs kar ha dkar po de las 'od 'phros ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug ha la thim/ ha lha dang bcas pa 'od du zhu bas kha dog phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa gyur/ ha ho hrīḥ lhan skyes dmar po'i thugs khar ho dmar po de las 'od 'phros ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug ho la thim/ ho lha dang bcas pa 'od du zhu bas dri phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa gyur/ ha ho hrīḥlhan skyes sngon po'i thugs khar/ hrīḥsngon po de las 'od 'phros/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug hrīḥl thim/ hrīḥlha dang bcas pa 'od du zhu bas ro bcud phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bdud rtsi byin brlabs/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/

sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ ma gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa yang dag pa dang*/ bden pa chen po 'di'i byin gyis brlabs dang*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i mthu la brten nas bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa 'di zhes bgyi bas/ bka' sdod ye shes kyi mgon po ma hā kā la lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la mchod pa 'bul zhing 'phrin las gnyan po bcol ba'i dus 'dir/ 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa sngags nyan pa la mi mos shing*/ phyag rgya blta ba la mi dbang ba'i bdud bgegs bar du gcod par byed pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di khyer la myur ba nyid du phyir dengs shig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag ye shes kyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar ba 'dis mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ hūm̐ nyon cig log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs// nga yi bka' las ma 'da' zhig /gal te bka' las 'das pa na// rdo rje me ltar 'bar ba yis// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing*// brlag par 'gyur bar gdon mi za// de yi nyen la ma bsdo bar// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di long la// myur ba nyid du phyir dengs shig /oṃ sumbha ni sumbha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛ hṇa gṛ hṇa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛ hṇa pa ya gṛ hṇa pa ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wan badzra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ hūm̐ bdag nyid dpal chen skur gyur te// dpal 'bar khros pa'i thugs ka nas// hūm̐ las 'phros pa'i me dpung 'bar// kha dog rnam lnga cher 'bar bas// steng yang me yi bla re la// me yi thog dang ser chen 'bab// 'og kyang me yi sa gzhi la// me yi rdo rje gcal du bkram// phyogs mtshams me yis gtams pa la// me yi 'du 'phro skar ltar 'khrug

/me dpung 'bar ba'i tsha tsha rnam par 'phro// 'dod chags 'joms pa'i me ni dmar nag 'bar// zhe sdang 'joms pa'i me ni mthing nag 'bar// gti mug 'joms pa'i me ni smug nag 'bar// nga rgyal 'joms pa'i me ni ser nag 'bar// phrag dog 'joms pa'i me ni ljang nag 'bar// ye shes lnga ldan log 'dren 'joms mdzad pa'i// 'bar ba me yi mtshams la ma 'da' zhig/ des chu dang bdud rtsi dkyil 'khor la gtor te bsnyen pa'i yi ge la 'jug par bya'o// hūm̐ ra las skyes pa khrag gi rgya mtsho ra// shar gyi rba rlabs dmar po nub tu 'phyo// nub kyi rba rlabs dmar po shar du 'phyo// ma mo bye ba'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig /ma las skyes pa zhag gi rgya mtsho ma// dkar dmar 'khrug cing g.yas kyi phyogs su 'khor// mi ro rta ro mang po rams se ram// sha za 'bum gyi tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig /su las skyes pa klad pa'i rgya mtsho su// kha dog dkar po cung zad dmar ba'i mdangs// mtho dma' med par rgya zho mnan pa 'dra// nag po stong gi tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig /'dod chags dag pa khrag gi rgya mtshor shar// zhe sdang dag pa zhag gi rgya mtshor shar// gti mug dag pa klad pa'i rgya mtshor shar// rigs gsum sprul pa'i mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo// kaṃ las skyes pa keṃ rus chen po kaṃ /kaṃ las me 'bar zur bzhir dud pa 'thul// gnam lcags 'dur mo rdo rje'i khong gzer btab// khro chu khol ma'i sbyin gyis bar mtshams bsdams// keng rus lhun po zhag 'dzag phyag 'tshal lo// hūm̐ las skyes pa rdo rje rgya gram hūm̐// steng du 'phros pas rdo rje'i gur bla bre// 'og tu 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur// logs su 'phros pas rdo rje'i rwa ba ste// phyi nas bltas pas me dpung gcig tu 'bar// nang nas bltas pas rdo rje'i gzhal yas khang*// rwa gur bar chad bsrung la phyag 'tshal lo// 'byung ba raṃ las skyes pa lhun stug cing*// rdo rje rwa ba gur dang me yi mtshams// me chu rlung dang mun pa stug po'i gnas// gcan gzan bsrung ba'i gnas la phyag 'tshal lo// dbus su bhruṃ las rin chen las grub pa'i// snod kyi gzhal yas gru bzhi'i shar phyogs ni// ke ke ru yi rang bzhin dkar po la// lho phyogs bai ḍūrya yi rang bzhin mthing*// nub phyogs padma rā ga'i rang bzhin dmar// byang phyogs ind+ra nī la'i rang bzhin ljang*// zur bzhi gser gyi cog bzhi btso ma'i mdog

/sgo bzhi rta babs rin chen du mas spras// phyi nang med pa gsal zhing rab tu mdzes// ye shes nyi zla'i skar khung ta la la// kha dog rnam lnga'i zer gyis 'phrin las mdzad// 'dod yon rgyas shing dur khrod brgyad kyis brgyan// lnga ldan gzhal yas khang la phyag 'tshal lo// de yi nang na bcud kyi gzhal yas khang*// thod pa skam rlon gnam lcags 'bar bas brtsigs// khrag chen spyin dang klad chen zhal ba byas// rta khrag mi yi khrag gis rab byugs pa// de yang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bcas// gza' ni chen po brgyad kyi gdung chen la// rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad lcam gyi tshul// de ltar nyi zla gnyis kyi ka gzhu la// rgyal po chen po bzhi yi ka bas bteg /tshangs pa brgya byin gnyis kyis ka gdan byas// klu yi rgyal po mtha' yas 'jog po yis// sgo yi skyes bu g.yas dang g.yon pa byas// klu yi rgyal po dga' bo nye dga' bos// ya them ma them byas nas phug ces sgrog /lha srin kunda li ni bsgral ba yis// sog pas phyogs bzhi yi ni sgo mo dang*// ma hā gser gyi ru sbal sgo lcibs byas// zhing chen g.yang gzhi'i thog phub zhing chung gi /g.yang gzhi'i 'phan gdugs nya sbal za ra tshags// rta ro mi ro gcal du phyogs mtshams bkram// gti mug mun gtibs nga rgyal brag ri brtsigs// phrag dog rlung 'tshub 'dod chags chu ltar 'brub// zhe sdang me 'bar mkha' 'gro ma mo dang*// gshin rje pho nya'i tshogs ni ma rungs pa// de 'dra'i gnas mchog dur khrod rgyan dang bcas// rab 'jigs bcud kyi gzhal yas khang la bstod// hūm̐ dbus su e las skyes pa chos kyi 'byung gnas e// gru gsum mthing nag sangs rgyas 'byon pa'i zhing*// nyi ma'i gdan bshams padma'i ge sar la// char sprin mdog 'dra'i hūm̐ mchog gyur pa las// dpal ldan lha chen mahā kā la ni// sku mdog mthing nag char sprin nag po'i mdog

/zhal cig phyag bzhi g.yas kyi dang po yis// bai ta'i 'bras bu rlon pa snying 'dra bsnams// g.yon gyi dang po ma rungs bdud bzhi yi// khrag gis rab tu gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin// g.yas kyi 'og ma ral gri 'debs pa'i tshul// g.yon gyi 'og ma rtse gsum 'phyar stabs 'dzin// thod pa skam po lnga yi cod pan la// rin chen sna tshogs rtse bran lnga yis brgyan// rus pa'i rgyan drug dag gis sku la spras// spyi gtsug nyi zla'i rgyan gyis rab tu mdzes// mgo rlon lnga bcu'i do shal mgul du 'phyang*// thal chen tshom bu lnga yi thig le dang*// zhag gi zo ras dag gis legs par brgyan// glang chen ko rlon sku yi stod du gsol// zhing lpags g.yang gzhi sku yi sked par dkris// stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs rab tu mdzes// klu chen rgyal rigs dkar pos dbu brgyan cing*// bram ze ser po mgul brgyan mdzes par dkris// rje rigs dmar pos rna ba g.yas g.yon brgyan// dmangs rigs ljang khras se ral kha byas shing*// gdol pa nag pos phyag gdub zhabs gdub byas// dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brjes pa'i tshul// spyan gsum las ni glog stong 'gyu ba'i gzi// sma ra ag tshom bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar// khro gnyer gsum ldan rin chen 'bar bas brgyan// gsus khyim che zhing lto ba 'thur du 'phyang*// ljags 'dril mche gtsigs drag po'i gad rgyang can// huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ kyi nga ro drag po sgrog /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum dpa' bo'i 'dug stangs kyis// ro yi gdan la dgyes pa'i gar gyis ni// ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs// dpal mchog ma hā kā la sku bzhengs shig /dpal 'bar dbang phyug chen po sku bzhengs shig /rdo rje khrag 'thung nag po sku bzhengs shig /lus dang grib ma'i tshul du bzhugs pa yi// yum mchog tsaṇḍi nag mo zhal gcig ma// phyag bzhi g.yas kyi dang po ral gri 'phyar// gnyis pa tri shu la ni 'bar ba 'dzin// g.yon gyi dang po mda' dang gzhu 'dzin cing*// 'og ma dgra bo'i mgo bcad khrag la bldag

/shin tu skem zhing skra grol ro gdan bzhugs// yum mchog tsaṇḍi nag mo sku bzhengs shig /g.yas kyi phyogs na bdud po bya rog gdong*// ging pho'i zhal nas phaṭ sgrog sku bzhengs shig /g.yon gyi phyogs na bdud mo bya rog gdong*// rab gtum zhal nas khrag 'dzag sku bzhengs shig /mdun gyi phyogs na srog bdag bya rog gdong*// gtum pa'i zhal nas hūm̐ mdzad sku bzhengs shig /rgyab kyi phyogs na btsan mgon bya rog gdong*// khrag 'thung rngam pa'i tshul gyis sku bzhengs shig /kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa// mdog nag gtum zhing thung la gel ba'i gzugs// phyag g.yas gri gug 'bar ba nam mkha' 'phyar// g.yon pa thod pa khrag bkang rngam zhing 'thung*// ral ser gyen brdzes mgo 'phreng do shal byas// sbrul gdug rgyan dang sku smad stag sham spras// zhabs g.yas rdeb cing ro yi gdan la bzhugs// las mkhan bya rog gdong can sku bzhengs shig /gzhan yang sangs rgyas spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i// gnod sbyin bya rog gdod can sku mdog ljang*// zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa gri gug 'phyar// g.yon pa thod pa nor bus gang ba gzung*// zhabs gnyis g.yon pa'i brang dang g.yas pus btsugs// bdud dang gnod sbyin mang po las la 'gyed// gnod sbyin 'bum gyi sde dpung bcas pa yang*// stobs chen dreg pa ma lus kun gyi rgyal// lha srin sha za 'bum sde'i 'khor dang bcas// bya khra dgu ni klad la lding zhing rgyug /gcan gzan 'bum ni phyi la rol zhing khrid// gnod sbyin bya rog gdong can sku bzhengs shig /khrag 'thung nag po'i spyan mngar khas blangs pa'i// srin po bya rog gdong can sprul pa'i sku// pha ni srin la ma ni klu mo ste// klu srin 'dus pa'i sras po mthu rtsal can// mgo dgu mgo lus thams cad mig gis khengs// sku mdog shin tu 'jigs pa'i dud kha'o// g.yas pa chu srin zhags pa'i rgyal mtshan bsnams// g.yon na rwa yi mda' gzhu 'dzin cing gzir// sku stod srin po'i gzugs la sku smad sbrul// sde brgyad dregs pa kun gyi dmag dpon mdzad// dam nyams dgra bo'i srog la hur thum byed// srin po bya rog gdong can sku bzhengs shig

/bka'i phyag brnyan seng ge'i gdong can ni// sku mdog mthing nag g.yas pa ral gri 'phyar// g.yon pa thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum ro yi gdan la bzhugs// rngam pa'i kha gdangs drag po'i mche ba gtsigs// sma ra me 'bar smin ma glog ltar 'khyug /thod pa lngas brgyan lcags kyi ral pa sprug /sbrul nag gdu bu mgo rlon do shal byas// stag lpags sham thabs dur khrod chas kyis brgyan// mi bsrun sha za'i tshogs kyi gtso bo ste// sha za seng ge'i gdong can sku bzhengs shig /shar sgor bya rgod gdong can sku bzhengs shig /byang sgor khyung gi gdong can sku bzhengs shig /nub sgor khwa ta'i gdong can sku bzhengs shig /lho sgor 'ug pa'i gdong can sku bzhengs shig /shar lhor phag gi gdong can= lho nub khyi yi gdong= nub byang spyang ki'i gdong can= byang shar stag gi gdong can sku bzhengs shig /kun kyang cha lugs mthun pa ste/ sku mdog mthing nag rngam pa'i tshul// thod 'phreng dur khrod chas kyis brgyan// phyag gnyis 'bar ba'i gri thod 'dzin// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar gyis bzhugs// mkha' 'gro brgyad po sku bzhengs shig /gzhan yang phyogs mtshams rgyug pa yi// ro langs brgya rnams sku bzhengs shig /nag po stong rnams sku= sha za 'bum rnams sku= ma mo sa ya sku= gnod sbyin khri rnams= phyi rol sde bzhi bsrung ba yi// rgyal chen sde bzhi= dur khrod brgyad na bzhugs pa yi// phyogs skyong zhing skyong sku= lha chen brgyad po= klu chen brgyad po= gnod sbyin brgyad po= gza' chen brgyad po= rgyu skar nyer brgyad= 'jigs byed dgu rnams= ma mo bdun dang srid mo bzhi// 'bar ma chen mo brgyad rnams dang*// pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi sogs// las byed pho nya sku bzhengs shig /de ltar gsal ba'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/

de las 'od zer 'phros pas bsil ba'i tshal na landa rdo rje gdan la sogs pa nas chos skyong ye shes kyi mgon po lcam dral khor dang bcas pa thams cad badzra sa mā dzaḥhūm̐ rgya gar yul kyi rdo rje gdan// 'gyur med rgyun tu brtan pa'i gnas// dus gsum sangs rgyas 'byon pa'i zhing*// rdo rje gdan gyi shar phyogs na// gtsug lag khang chen na landa'i// chos skyong srung mar mnga' gsol ba'i// ye shes mgon po bya rog mtshan// khrag 'thung rgyal po'i sprul pa ste// bstan pa bsrung phyir 'jigs pa'i gzugs// nag po chen po mthu rtsal can// lha srin sde brgyad 'khor gyis bskor// khams gsum ma lus dbang du sdud// dgra bgegs thams cad rdul du rlog /bdud dgra 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo// hūm̐ khyod la bstod cing zhu ba ni// da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus// gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// sems can bde la 'god pa dang*// sgrub bo bdag gi re skong phyir// thun mong mchog gi mchod pa rnams// khyod la 'bul gyi bzhes slad du// 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// thugs rjes dgongs la myur du byon// zhes spyan drangs/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i mthu rtsal can// dpal ldan ma hā kā la 'khor dang bcas// bdud dang bar chad ma lus 'dul ba dang*// drag po'i dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir// drag po gzhal yas chen po'i gnas mchog 'dir// gnyis med brtan par bzhugs la 'phrin las mdzod// oṃ badzra ma hā kā la sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥpadma ka ma la ye st+waṃ/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ pu ṣpe/ dhu pe/ a lo ke gandhe/ naiwi dye/ shapta

sa mchod/ ye shes mgon po 'khor dang bcas// sngon gyi zhal bzhes dgongs mdzod la// rdo rje 'chang gi bka' ma bcag /dkon mchog gsum gyi dam ma bral// sngags 'chang rnams kyi ngag ma gcog /gal te dam las 'das gyur na// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// thugs mchog rdo rje 'bar ba 'dis// 'khor bcas brlag par gdon mi za// oṃ badzra ma hā kā la sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis rgyal ba rigs lnga spyan drangs/ de rnams kyi bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur bas sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la bde mchog lhan skyes/ 'khor rnams la ye shes kyi mgon po nyid kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ 'o ma chu gtsang sbyar ba yi// yid 'ong mchod yon phyag tu 'bul// oṃ badzra ma hā kā la arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ tsan dan gla rtsi sbyar ba yi// zhal bsil dam pas sku khrus gsol// pā dyaṃ= sa bcu nyid la gnas pa'i sems dpa' yang*// gzi brjid me ltar 'bar ba'i khro tshul gyis// bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa// mgon po 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// hūm̐ rakta skom du 'thung ba'i phyir// khrag sna stong gi yon chab 'di// mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bstan pa rgyas par mdzod/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ phaṭ/ spyan gzigs sha la mdzad pa'i phyir// sha sna stong gi me tog 'di// mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bstan pa rgyas par mdzod// puṣpe= tshil chen dri la mnom pa'i phyir// bsur chen spos kyi dud sprin 'di// mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bstan pa rgyas par mdzod// dhū pe= srin po gdug pa 'joms pa'i phyir// zhun chen gsal ba'i mar me 'di// mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bstan pa rgyas par mdzod/ ā lo ke= nus pa mchog dang rab ldan phyir// bdud rtsi lnga yi dri chab 'di// mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bstan pa rgyas par mdzod// gandhe=

ljags kyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir// snying sna stong gi zhal zas 'di// mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bstan pa rgyas par mdzod// nai wi dye= snyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir// rkang gling thod lnga cang ti'u sogs// mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bstan pa rgyas par mdzod// shapta= chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i pho brang du// drin can rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma la// rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// oṃ ma hā gu ru sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i gnas mchog dam pa ru// bcom ldan 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs la// rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ oṃ shrī he ru ka= gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du// bka' sdod ye shes mgon po chen po la// rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la= mgon po'i sku dang gnyis med lhan sbyor ba'i// e ka dza ṭi gsang ba'i yum chen la// rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ ma hā kā li= drag po'i las byed bya rog gdong can sogs// bka' nyan las byed dregs pa'i tshogs rnams la// rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// oṃ ma hā kā la gu ṇa hri da= gzhan yang mgon po'i bka' nyan las byed tshogs// 'phrin las bzhi yis bstan pa skyong mdzad cing*// rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i bar chad kun sel ba'i// dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchod pa 'bul// gnas bdag gzhi bdag rigs drug mchod sbyin gnas// rang rang 'dod pa'i dngos grub ji lta ba// 'bad med stsol bas nye bar 'tsho ba yi// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i char rgyun dbab gyur cig

/sarba pañtsa= rang rdzas mdzes pa nyid kyi rdzas// stong dang shin tu stong pa dang*// stong pa chen po'i rgyud de yis// thams cad stong pa mngon sum du// byas la bde chen skad cig gis// goms par byas la mchod par bya// man ngag bzhin/ oṃ badzra ka wu wa ma hā kā lā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces bzlas so// hūm̐ 'og min gnas mchog dam pa yi// lcang lo can gyi pho brang na// dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa yi// 'khor du dpa' bo dpa' mos bskor// za byed rngam pa'i khro gtum can// bdud dpung thams cad 'joms mdzad pa// khrag 'thung rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod// he ru ka dpal sku sprul pa// bka' sdod bya rog mtshan can ni// nag po chen po khro bo'i rgyal// keng rus skam rlon khri la bzhugs// gcer bu sku mdog nag po la// thal ba'i mtshan mas lus byugs pa// gzung 'dzin dri mas ma gos shing*// chos sku 'gyur ba med pa'i rtags// dgra bgegs 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyag bzhi yi ni brda bstan pa// 'phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub pa'i rtags// phyag g.yas dang po be ta yi// 'bras bu dmar po 'dzin mdzad pa// longs spyod dngos grub ster ba'i rtags// rin chen gter gyi char 'bebs pa'i// gter bdag chen por phyag 'tshal bstod// phyag g.yas 'og ma ral gri 'dzin// dgra bgegs srog rtsa gcod pa'i rtags// phyag g.yon dang po thod khrag bsnams// bdud khrag dron mo gsol ba'i rtags// phyag g.yon 'og ma rtse gsum bsnams// sku gsum yon tan mnga' ba'i rtags// skyon med sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// mche bzhi gtsigs pas bdud bzhi 'joms// 'byung po'i sha la rol pa'i rtags// spyan gsum sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs// sprul pa'i pho nya 'gyed pa'i rtags// khro gnyer dpral ba'i dbyings su bsdus// gnod byed tshe srog 'gugs pa'i rtags// dam tshig can la phyag 'tshal bstod// dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs ni// bskal pa'i me ltar gyen du 'bar// lha rnams dbang du sdud pa'i rtags// sbrul rigs bzhi yis dbu zhabs brgyan// klu rnams dbang du sdud pa'i rtags// ag tshom kham nag 'khyil ba ni// lha min g.yul ngo 'joms pa'i rtags// bya rog ming can phyag 'tshal bstod// thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan// rigs lnga'i rgyan dang ldan pa'i rtags// thod rlon 'phreng ba'i do shal rgyan// dam nyams srog rtsa gcod pa'i rtags// dpa' bo'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa// bsgral ba'i zhing bcu sgrol ba'i rtags// sku smad stag lpags sham thabs ni// gcan gzan 'khor gyis bskor ba'i rtags// dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra sgrog pa// phyogs bcur snyan pa sgrog pa'i rtags// bya rog ming can phyag 'tshal bstod// me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs// nyon mongs rnam rtog sreg pa'i rtags// bya rog ming can phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐

dpal ldan mgon po nag po yi// dpral ba'i dkyil nas sku sprul pa// lcags kyi bya khyung nag po ni// dung gi mche ba rab gtsigs shing*// spyan ni khrag mdog bse yi spyan// rwa ni rdo rje pha lam rwa// rin chen 'bar ba'i tsha tsha 'phro// mthing gshog 'bar ba gdengs mig g.yob// kaṃ kaṃ kriṃ kriṃ sgra 'byin zhing*// zangs kyi sder mo dmar po yis// dgra bgegs glo snying phyung nas ni// rngam zhing rngam zhing zhal du gsol// khyung nag sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ thugs kyi dkyil nas sprul pa ni// bya rog gdong can nag po che// zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa la// g.yas pa bdud kyi gri gug 'phyar/ g.yon pa bdud khrag dron mo gsol// mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal byas// sku smad stag gi sham thabs bgyis// 'gying zhing 'gying zhing dgra la rol// rngam zhing rngam zhing dgra sha za// spyan gsum sdang mig glog ltar 'khyug /rgyu ma'i ga shas lus brgyan nas// khro zhing khro zhing bgegs rnams 'joms// hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ kyi sgra sgrog cing*// lha min thams cad 'byer bar byed// legs ldan nag po khro bo'i gzugs// bya rog bgegs 'joms phyag 'tshal bstod// dam can yongs kyi srung ma che// dam nyams yongs kyi gshed po che// mna' zan yongs kyi sha zan po// rnal 'byor yongs kyi dgra lha che// bdud 'dul yongs kyi dbang phyug che// dug gsum nad kyi sman pa'i rgyal// lha yi dge bsnyen chen po ste// bya rog gdong can khyod la bstod// lha dmag kun gyi dbugs 'byin pa// nam mkha'i bu mo glog ma sprin// 'dul bar zhal gyis bzhes mdzad pa// rdo rje dur khrod ro langs 'dul// bdud 'dul dbang phyug khyod la bstod// gzhan yang thugs kyi sprul pa ni// gnod sbyin bya rog gdong can te// bstan pa bsrung la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyag brnyan legs ldan seng ge'i gdong*// gtsang ris mgon po chen po ste// mgon po 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor// rnal 'byor bdag gis khyod bsgrub kyi// bos pa'i dus na snyan ma sra// rbad pa'i dus na mthu ma chung*// rnal 'byor lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs// hūm̐

lha mo dus mtshan re ma ti// e ka dza ṭi sngags kyi yum// zhal gcig ma la spyan gsum ma// phyag bzhi ma la mdzes ma ste// phyag g.yas ral gri tri shu la// g.yon pa mda' gzhu dgra mgo 'dzin// sku mdog nag mo dre'u zhon// ral pa kham nag sa la rdol// yang 'khor ma mo bye bas bskor// rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod// hūm̐ dpal ldan mgon po nag po yi// shar na sprul pa'i pho nya ni// ma mo bya rgod gdong can ma// sku mdog nag mo mun pa'i mdog /phyag g.yas ral gri 'bar ba 'phyar// g.yon pa thod pa khrag can gsol// spyan gsum skra grol gcer bu ma// zangs kyi mche ba rab gtsigs nas// rgod cing rgod cing ro la za// bya rgod gdong can khyod la bstod// byang na khyung gi gdong can ma// sku mdog nag mo char sprin mdog /ral pa phur bu sa la 'drud// g.yas g.yon 'bar ba'i gri thod 'dzin// spyan gsum= bse yi mche ba= mchong zhing mchong zhing bgegs la rol// khyung gi gdong= nub na khwa ta'i gdong can ma// sku mdog nag mo dud kha la// ral pa kham nag g.yon du 'khyil// phyag gnyis 'bar ba'i gri thod 'dzin// spyan gsum= shel gyi mche ba rab gtsigs nas// lding zhing lding zhing dgra rnams gsod// khwa ta'i gdong can= lho na 'ug pa'i gdong can ma// sku mdog nag mo mthing gi mdog /khrag gi ral pa dmar po gzings// ral gri thod khrag phyag na bsnams// spyan gsum= lcags kyi mche ba rab gtsigs nas// rgyug cing rgyug cing dam nyams sgrol// 'ug pa'i gdong can khyod la bstod// khyod kyi thugs kyi sprul pa ni// shar lho mtshams na phag gi gdong*// phag rgod 'bum gyi pho nya 'gyed// dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog /bdud dgra 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod// lho nub mtshams na khyi gdong ma// bdud khyi 'bum gyi= dgra bgegs thal= bdud dgra 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod// nub byang mtshams na spyang gdong ma// spyang mo 'bum=

dgra bgegs= bdud dgra 'dul la= byang shar mtshams na stag gdong ma// stag mo 'bum= dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog /bdud dgra 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ tshogs rdzas rnams bdud rtsi ril bus bsang gtor byas nas/ lag pa g.yon pa gdengs/ oṃ yig tu song bas sbyangs/ g.yas pa gdengs/ āḥyig gi rtogs pa ste mang por spel/ snyim pa bkab/ hūm̐ yig gis sbar ba ste kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs par byas/ nam mkha' lding gi phyag rgyas/ hoḥzag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor zhu bar bsams la/ hūm̐ dbyings srid zhi kun tu 'char ba'i ma// dpal rdo rje yan lag ma mo'i 'phrul// mtshan kun ldan ye shes ka pā la// de bsam gyis mi khyab nam mkha' tsam// a rā li rnal 'byor gyi 'dus pa la// 'dod yon gyi longs spyod mi zad pa// ha ho hrīḥkha dog dri ro'i tshogs// mchog rnam pa kun ldan stong pa'i dpyid// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sbyangs rtogs sbar bas na/ dpal mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i gnas// sa ha dza so so rang rig gis// kha sbyor gyi 'khor lo gcig tu bsdams// tshogs la spyan drangs/ hūm̐ thugs zung 'jug rgyal ba kun gyi dngos// gsung chos kyi 'khor lo thams cad pa// sku rnam pa kun ldan tshogs kyi mchog /skyabs gsum gyi 'dus pa bla ma rje// 'khor brgyud pa'i bla ma nyil li li// sku mdzes pa'i rus rgyan khro lo lo// gsung theg chen chos sgra 'ur ru ru// thugs dgyes pa'i gar stabs ling nge nge*// nged bu slob tshogs kyi dpon la gshegs// bcud dam rdzas rnams la byin rlabs zhu// mchog thun mong dngos grub gnang nas kyang*// yab khyed dang nyams par byin gyis rlobs// dkyil 'khor gyi padma'i snying po kun// ris med pa rgyal ba'i ze'u 'brus gang*// dngos grub kyi zil dngar ci dang ci// yid bzhin du 'byung ba lhag pa'i lha// 'khor yi dam lha tshogs nyi li li// sku=

gsung= thugs= nged= bcud= mchog= lha khyed dang= nang ye shes nyi ma zla ba'i rdzu// bar chad kyi mun pa mthar byed cing*// yid skyob kyi snang ba kun ston pa// yum rdo rje btsun mo rigs lnga'i sde// 'khor dpa' bo ḍā ki= sku= gsung= thugs= nged= bcud= mchog= ma khyed dang= khong bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo rlag byed du// dpal rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i snying rje'i stobs// lha mi bzad khros pa dpa' bo'i ste// mgon ma hā kā la lcam dral rnams// 'khor dregs pa'i lha srin= sku= gsung= thugs= nged= bcud= mchog= mgon khyed dang mnyam par byin gyis rlobs// tshogs kyi mchod pa/ rje srid zhi'i phan pa thams cad du// chu zla bzhin 'gog pa med shar ba// dpal dang po'i mgon po bla ma'i zhabs// bka' brgyud kyi rje btsun rgya mtsho la// mi bdag gi lus dge longs spyod kun// sngags gsang ba chen po'i dam tshig rdzas// ci spyad kyang mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod// 'dod yon gyi dpyid du sbar te 'bul// tshogs gnyis kyi lang tshos rab gang zhing*// sgrib gnyis kyi sprin las rnam grol ba'i// dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer gyis// nam mkha' srid 'gengs pa'i nus pa zhu// zhi ba dang khro chags thams cad pa// sgyu 'phrul gyi zlos gar la shar nas// dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i mgon mdzad pa// yi dam gyi lha tshogs rgya mtsho la/ mi= sngags= ci= 'dod= tshogs= sgrib= dpal= nam mkha'= 'khor 'das kyi ngo mtshar ma lus pa// gnyis med la gnyis su ston byed pa'i// sras rgyal ba thams cad skyed pa'i yum// dpa' bo dang ḍā ki? rgya mtsho la// mi= sngags= ci= 'dod= tshogs= sgrib= dpal= nam mkha' srid 'gengs= bdud tshogs la bdud dang chos par gnyen// snying rje las rnam pa thams cad pa// khrag 'thung gi rgyal po dga' mar bcas// dam can gyi chos skyong rgya mtsho la/ mi= sngags= ci= 'dod= tshogs= sgrib= dpal= nam mkha' srid 'gengs pa'i nus pa zhu//

bshags pa ni/ ma hā kā la gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ nag po chen po'i dkyil 'khor sgor zhugs nas// bka' yi dam tshig gnyan po bsrung rgyu la// bka' ltar ma gyur gzhung bzhin rngo ma thogs// brnyen bsgrub dus 'das phud dang gtor ma chag /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa kun// rdo rje srin po 'khor dang bcas la bshags//

bskang ba/ hūm̐ dam can 'dir spyon 'bod rdzas rlung chen g.yo// dbyangs snyan rol sgra khol ba'i mchod sprin 'thibs// dam tshig gis brnangs gdung ba'i gru char sogs// 'du ba'i dam rdzas bsags pas thugs dam bskang*// chos dang rjes su mthun pa'i chos sgrub la// dgyes nas 'khor ba de tsam gzhan dag gis// ci ltar mchod la'ang mi mdzad des mgu nas// bstod bkur bsngags pa phyag gis= gdugs phyogs bla bre rgyal mtshan 'phan phur gdugs// bar snang lda ldi lhab lhub mda' dar bar// gzhu can 'dod dgur 'char ba'i dbang po'i gzhu// bskang byed phan tshun sbrel bas= rngam rngam gshin rje'i mdzod rdzas dgra cha'i sde// mtshar mtshar 'dogs par rings pa'i rgyan cha dang*// lhag lhag rngom brjid 'os pa'i nor sna tshogs// phung phung bkod pa rgya mtshos= sna tshogs g.yang gzhi'i rgyal mtshan chos 'byung du// srub mthong phrag dog gi rbad ru mtshon rtse// mthor bsnyeg sngo bsangs ma la bsnun la khad// 'phyar dar lag pas bzlog 'dras= nam mkha' 'dab chags 'phur dgus mun par gtibs// sa gzhi rmig chags rnams kyis rdzis pa'i khar// mi bzad sder chags khyu chen brdal nas su// so so'i rten du phul bas= sna tshogs gzi mdangs lhun du chags pa'i tshe// dkar dmar zla nyi tog tu chas gyur cing*// mthun rdzas rgyu skar mdzes pa'i rgyan byas pa// ba ling pho brang chen pos= dur khrod chas brgyad sbrul brgyad rus rgyan lnga// ma mo'i chas ka phod ka nag po'i zhwa// stag gzig dom ral ma ral gdong brnyan dang*// chas bcug 'chams kyi gzigs mos= yas thags las kyi me long chen po der// snang zhing srid gzugs snang ba 'di gzigs nas// gshis lugs bden med bsgyur la brdzun min glud// long zhu'i smreng dang bcas pas= rang rang srog gis legs bsdams bla rdo yis// gau rir 'khyud pas 'bral bar ma phod pas// sku gzugs glegs bam phyag mtshan gnyan po'i rtags// ci dga' zhing du spel bas=

hūm̐ gnod byed dgra bo'i gshed du mngags pa'i tshe// bsrung ba'i go bgos zlog pa'i bkod bshams nas// bsad pa'i g.yul zhugs mnan bsreg 'phang la sogs// drag po nag po'i mthu yis thugs dam bskang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gnyer kha 'dzin pa'i tshe// lam gol sun phyungs rgyu 'bras yid ches pas// sdig spong dge bsgrub rang gi sems 'dul ba// zhi ba dkar po'i chos kyis thugs dam bskang*// dug gsum nad kyi sman pa mdzad pa'i tshe// bskyed pa'i rim gsal dag dran nga rgyal gyis// tha mal snang zhen na ba'i skabs phral nas// rang byin brlabs gso phyag rgyas= dam pa chos kyi srog shing mdzad pa'i tshe// dgra dang grogs brtsis rnal bzlog dkrug dbyung sdeb// 'phrul bskor dgra tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// chos kyi gaṇḍī brdungs bas= bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i dpa' bor zhugs pa'i tshe// rig pa'i ral gris bden pa'i srog bcad cing*// stong nyid mdung rtser sna tshogs ro 'thor ba// dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bus= zhing skyong legs ldan chen por sprul pa'i tshe// phyin nang sreg blugs 'og zhal ho mar dang*// phyugs bsad khrag gis steng gi zhal bkang nas// tshangs pa'i srin por bsnyen pas thugs dam bskang*// gtor ma sba bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ laṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu/ de'i steng du a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs pa'i nang du gtor rdzas sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga'i phung po/ dgra bgegs thams cad thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis de nyid du bkug bsgral ba'i sha khrag dang gnyis su med par bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i 'od kyi sbu gu can du gyur pas/ bdud rtsi drangs te gsol bas mnyes par bsam/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ badzra ka wu wa ma hā kā la i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi

btags pa dang oṃ ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na u pa hā ri ṇe/ eṣa a pañtsi ma kā laḥ.a yaṃ/ i daṃ ratna trā yā ya/ a pa kā ri ṇāṃ/ ya di pra ti dzñā sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṃṣṭaṃ/ ba lingta*/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛ hna gṛ hna/ bandha bandha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ dī na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ lan bdun gyis phul/ dpal ldan mgon po ma hā kā la dam can yongs kyi stongs grogs/ dam nyams yongs kyi srog gcod/ mna' zan yongs kyi sha zan/ lha yi dge bsnyen chen po/ lha dmag kun gyi dbugs 'byin pa/ nam mkha'i bu lha ma yin gyi bu mo glog ma sprin 'dul bar zhal gyis bzhes pa/ rdo rje dur khrod ro langs kyi bdag po/ bdud 'dul gyi dbang phyug chen po/ bka' sdod ye shes kyi mgon po phyag brnyan bya rog gdong can/ gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga la sogs pa khyed rnams rnal 'byor bdag gi chos skyong du bskos pa yin pas/ dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ rnal 'byor bdag gi lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs par mdzad du gsol/ dpal ldan lha mo dus mtshan ma nag mo lha mo nag mo re ma ti/ yum e ka dza ṭi/ gnod sbyin lcam dral khyed rnams kyis rnal 'byor pa bdag la sdang ba'i dgra thul cig gnod pa'i bgegs thul cig bos pa'i dus na snyan ma sra// rbad pa'i dus mthu ma chung*// nyin gyi dus na bya ra gyis/ mtshan gyi dus na mel tshe mdzod/ legs dang sprod/ nyes dang snol/ bsam pa sgrubs/ re ba skongs/ bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzad du gsol/ ces 'dod don gsol// arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ tshogs la 'dod pa lnga ldan du rol/ lhag ma bsdus kha phru btab ste/ hūm̐ ma rdo rje btsun mo khros pa'i gzugs// 'khor gnas dang pho nya 'jig rten pa// dam tshig dang sha za'i ḍā ki? ma// mdangs dkar ser dmar ljang sngo dang khra// lus glog 'khyug me dpung 'ur ru ru// ngag gshug glu zhud po dir ri ri// yid sangs rgyas bstan la dung nge nge*// las srid gsum myul la shar ra ra// mtho nam mkha'i dbyings nas bya ra byed// dam nyams pa'i steng du thog tu 'bab// bar dur khrod kun tu rgyu zhing 'phur// dgra tho lum 'bar ba'i ro ru za// dma' rgya mtsho'i klong nas gyen la rgyug

/mi dam nyams bsgral nas khrag la 'thung*// nad brgyad khri bzhi stong kun gyi bdag /pho mtshar po kun gyi snying la 'jug /mo mtshar mo thams cad zhe yis gnon// gnas dben par bsgom pa'i drod tshad myul// khyed dgyes pa'i lhag gtor bshams nas 'bul// nged skal ldan dga' ba'i dngos grub zhu// oṃ u tstshiṣṭa ba liṃ ta bhakṣa bhyaḥswā hā/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis nyes pa bshags/ rten yod na/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ sogs kyi de la bsdu/ med na 'od kyis dam tshig ye shes pa gnyis su med par rang la bstim/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ye shes mgon po 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba cig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'khod par shog/ ces bsngo/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong rnams kyi bkra shis brjod do// mi dbang don grub rdo rje'i rgyun gyi nyams bzhes su padma dkar pos rdo rje gling du sbyar ba'o/// /maṅga laṃ/// /
